_what: Stage 03. The three structures this paper determines, built with curation/lib/assemble atom-map attachment.
build_route: assemble.attach(head[N:1], alkyl[CH2:2]) per tail; the second tail re-tags the unique acyclic secondary amine via SMARTS [NX3;H1;!R], asserted to match exactly once
no_stereocentres: asserted per structure; this chemistry is achiral, so the F-013 chiral-tag class cannot arise -- but the connectivity class still can, which is why the 1H integral sum is carried separately

structures.structure_source: full IUPAC name printed in the SI, corroborated by HRMS and the 1H integral sum

not_determinable.why_no_structure: Crude one-pot product. Table S1 reports BOTH a 1-tail and a 2-tail species for amine 1 + C12 and the paper purified 1C12-D and 1C16-S/D out of exactly these mixtures, so the screened material is a mixture of at least two compounds in an unreported ratio. One SMILES would be a fabrication.
